title: Celestial Grid Offering
description: A surreal painting depicts a glowing 4x4 grid of blue squares containing golden chalices or bells, each topped with small star-like bursts. The background features soft pastel light rays in yellow and white with floating peach-colored abstract forms above the grid.
prompt: A dreamy surreal painting of a 4x4 glowing blue grid on a light surface, each square containing a golden glowing chalice or bell topped with radiant star bursts and sparkles. Soft pastel yellow and white light rays descend from above, with translucent peach abstract shapes floating in the upper space, all rendered in a soft impressionistic style with visible brushstrokes and delicate splatters.
